purpose: Add a separate source-bound record-association and successful integration-call ledger to the bounded full-bag example. Preserve existing mapping-state schema 1 and synchronization/geometry semantics. This is traceability, not measured physical synchronization or voxel/accuracy qualification.

fixed_contract.identity: Reference immutable sorted MemoryEpisode record indices, sensor role, raw/corrected times and source point counts. Bind the report to verified input/calibration SHA-256 and sizes, selected topics, registered frames/root, correction model/anchor/quality, chunk size and sync window. Episode indices are not physical-message IDs; never serialize addresses or duplicate point payloads.
fixed_contract.matching: Use the unchanged DeterministicReplayer nearest-neighbor policy: inclusive time/uncertainty windows, first stable tie, reusable rear records. Store each actual front/rear association and delta with stable episode indices. Reject duplicate selected-topic corrected times and foreign/invalid episode references. Validate a completed ledger against the independently supplied expected context and exact episode, including replaying the original association policy.
fixed_contract.integration: Count a front/rear visit only after the corresponding TSDF call succeeds. The current integrator returns cloud.len(), which is submitted point count, not voxel contribution. Reject double/missing calls, wrong returned point counts, overflow and summary disagreement. A completed execution must reconcile every front call and every selected association with existing integrated-record/point totals. Expose matched/unmatched/reused and unique visited record counts separately from visit counts; do not claim unique physical-message, voxel or geometric coverage.
fixed_contract.bounds: Fail closed before odometry on more than 65,536 retained records. Bound actual descriptor/association/validation array capacities plus bounded header storage to 8MiB; individual identity labels are at most 1,024 bytes and total header string capacity is bounded. JSON streams through a 16KiB buffer to a newly created temporary file with a 32MiB byte cap including its newline. These metadata/output limits are separate from existing source/episode scalar limits and are not process-RSS guarantees.
fixed_contract.publication: Publish full-bag-mapping.coverage.json only after successful integration and ledger validation. Atomically create the destination without replacing an existing file; clean only the exact temporary file created by that attempt. Link its checksum/size via a new artifact role and existing DatasetManifest. Artifact IO/limit errors must occur before a successful parent mapping state is written. Blocked runs keep their diagnostic state and omit the coverage artifact. Keep old serialized state fields/version and all library APIs/dependencies unchanged.
fixed_contract.admission: Preserve source path/size/SHA and calibration registration, actual sensor-frame checks, bounded collection, clock correction, trajectory binding, scan transport, odometry/TSDF algorithms, physical accuracy gates and disk preflight. New hard metadata/output caps are explicit example admission conditions. No hidden device copies, unsafe, dependency, thread or synthetic timing evidence.

verification: Commit this protocol before native execution. This is an additive feature: first pass characterization tests against the original replayer without inventing a failing legacy ledger API. Cover ties, inclusive/outside windows, uncertainty, reuse, unmatched/empty streams and stable indices. Then test ledger totals, actual integration recording, forged context/indices/deltas/counts, omitted/duplicate calls, capacity/arithmetic limits, bounded/no-clobber atomic JSON IO, round trips and synthetic SQLite full-run publication/blocked admission. Run both examples, ROS2/records/sync/mapping/viewer/calibration controls, all-target Clippy and format. Preserve all evidence and use the existing three-OS jobs plus all 131 required checks.

resources.preservation: Hash-protect prior scientific JSON, all 42 frozen native artifacts, pinned sources and completed room outputs. Reuse the cache, preserve failed logs and never rebuild frozen binaries. No real sensor read/download/copy or real-motion fit. Synthetic SQLite/JSON fixtures stay in the owned external temp directory.

remaining_80_percent: Native full-room accuracy and genuinely unobserved motion; both qualifying raw Linux hardware classes; matching canonical measured clock uncertainty and physical frame accuracy; complete canonical mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange/release acceptance. Successful record-submission traceability does not establish these requirements.
